descriptions.phpstan: PHPStan at the maximum level, then the witnesses that prove each forbidden call is still reported.
descriptions.deptrac: The layers, generated from the composer.json and phil-dev.php of each package.
descriptions.test:services: The Integration suite against the MySQL, PostgreSQL and Gotenberg of phil-dev services.
descriptions.infection: Mutation testing of the whole code at 100 % of covered mutants.
descriptions.infection:changed: Mutation testing of the files changed since the base ref (PHIL_DEV_BASE_REF, else origin/main), once per batch.
descriptions.test:next: The tests on the next PHP of the matrix, in its Docker image.
descriptions.infection:next: Mutation testing of the whole code on the next PHP of the matrix, weekly and before a release.
descriptions.docs: The documentation checks of each package.
descriptions.paquets: Each package installed on its own, with its dependency analysis and its tests.
descriptions.paquets:next: The same, on the next PHP of the matrix.
